answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the beacon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A quartz of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ocean of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
